name: Charu Majumdar
contribution: He articulated and organized a radical Maoist current that shaped late-1960s and early-1970s left politics in West Bengal.
context: Amid agrarian inequality and Cold War-era ideological polarization, his politics emerged through the Naxalbari-linked revolutionary line.
impact: He remains a contested but central reference in discussions of revolutionary left politics in Bengal.
highlight: A key and contested architect of the Naxalite political line in West Bengal.
seoTitle: Charu Majumdar: Naxalite Politics in West Bengal
seoDescription: Explore Charu Majumdar’s role in the Naxalite political line, radical left organizing, and the contested history of revolutionary politics in West Bengal.
shortAnswer: Charu Majumdar was a radical left organizer and a central, contested figure in the Naxalite politics of late-1960s and early-1970s West Bengal.
